description: This file defines a utility for aggregating agent usage and costs from MongoDB collections related to session tracking and LLM costs. It includes functions for parsing currency-like strings, building aggregation pipelines, and merging data from multiple sources to produce summarized reports.

methods.name: toNumberSafe(value)
methods.description: Safely parses strings representing currency or numbers into JavaScript Number type, handling various formats with symbols like '$' and commas.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost( db, { tenant_id, project_id, from, to, limit = 50, offset = 0, } = {} )
methods.description: Main function that performs aggregation over session_tracking and llm-costs collections, merging data regarding agent costs and token usage with optional filters for tenant, project, and date range.
